dialogs.text: This is definitely gonna be a surprise for Raef... Hehe...
What surprise?
Whoa! Don't scare me like that, Traveler!
It's not like I sneaked up on you...
I was thinking about something, so I didn't notice you.
Traveler, have you heard of something called "perfume"?
Granny Jawahir told me that she used to make perfume when she was young...
Not only can they cover up the smell of sweat on people's bodies, certain types of perfume have invigorating properties...
Raef has to guard the village all the time. He's always really sweaty from the heat and often complains about the sunlight making him dizzy...
So I wanna make a bottle of Mint perfume for him.
Granny Jawahir wrote down the recipe for making perfume and helped me buy the ingredients...
But making perfume is so much trickier than I expected... Just getting the ingredients ready took me a really long time. I made lots of mistakes along the way, too...
If things go on like this, Raef's gonna find out I'm making perfume for him!
Traveler, could you help me prepare some ingredients? Be careful not to let Raef discover anything, okay?
Why not?
I've been preparing this surprise for a long time. I'm not gonna let him know and ruin it all now!
It's not a lot of work. Go find Mr. Azalai and pick up the goods I ordered, then fetch a small bucket of water. That's all!
Remember to keep it on the down low. Don't let Raef know!
...Leave it to me then.
Thanks once again. Don't worry, I'll be sure to make it worth your while!
Traveler, what are you busy with this time? Running around like that...
Oh yeah, have you been helping Nermin with anything lately? Or... perhaps heard any rumors about her?
It feels like she's been really busy, but I have no idea what's going on...
She... Um... She's busy taking care of her flowers.
Is that so? But I didn't see any new flower pots in her house...
She... Um... She's busy cooking.
Huh? Is Hilmi and the others asking her for Minty Bean Soup again?
These kids... I need to talk to them when I have the time.
Welcome! What do you need today?
About Nermin's order...
Oh, Nermin's order... I have it prepared right here. These are all high-quality ingredients, and they're inexpensive, too.
I'm guessing Nermin wants to make some perfume with these ingredients, right?
*sigh* It's a good thing to be enthusiastic, but Nermin needs to take better care of herself...
How should I go about this step again? My notes... Where are my notes...

Great, I still have some remaining ingredients from last time. With the new stuff you brought, I'll get to try a few more times before making the final product.
Whew... Let me look over my notes again. I'm sure I'll make it work this time!
Oh, I need a few flower petals as well...
Nermin nervously starts making the perfume...
It's done! It smells pretty nice... And it didn't turn out all sticky either...
That means I've succeeded this time, right...?
Feels like it.
Yeah! Look, I even bought a bottle to put the perfume in!
Traveler, let's go give the perfume to Raef together. I hope he'll like it...
At least it's not a failure.

Nermin, and... the Traveler. What brings you here? Did you run into trouble?
Don't tell me something's wrong with the flowers... I'm still on duty right now... When I'm done, I'll...
Nermin has something for you.
Here, this bottle of perfume is for you! It's Mint-scented.
I wanted to make it smell like Zaytun Peaches at first... But for some reason, once I added them into the mixture, the perfume became all sticky...
Th—Thank you. But what is this... "perfume" supposed to be for?
Helping you stay alert! It also helps cover up the smell of your sweat. Don't you feel dizzy from getting drenched in sweat all day?
Uh, I guess I'm used to it. It might feel a little awkward if the smell's suddenly gone...
Then don't use it. I'm taking it back.
Hey, wait! I was just joking!
Give me that perfume, quick! I'm starting to feel dizzy...
Here you go. You just have to apply it onto your arms — that's what Granny Jawahir said.
The smell's not bad, and it's indeed quite refreshing. It feels nice and cool on my arms...
Hmph! It's Granny Jawahir's secret recipe after all.
I got to make such wonderful perfume thanks to the Traveler's help.
I just helped a little.
Please forgive me for asking so many favors of you...
These are for you. Just think of them as your compensation... Thank you so much.
This perfume is indeed pretty handy...
But... uh... Nermin, why are there red spots forming where I've applied it...?
*cough*... The smell... This doesn't seem right...
Are you alright?
I'm fine! I accidentally messed up a step in the procedure. Another failed attempt...
But let's not talk about that for now. Did you get the ingredients?
Yes, got them right here.
